panels.title: Pending — lands with the resilience patterns (M7)

options.content:
## Pending (M7)

This dashboard is provisioned but intentionally has no query panels yet.

Timeouts, retries with backoff and circuit breakers are designed in [fault-tolerance-design](../resilience/fault-tolerance-design.md) and validated by the chaos tests in **M7**. Until those code paths exist there is nothing to count, and a panel querying a metric nobody exports renders `No data` indefinitely — indistinguishable from an outage.

**Planned panels**

| Panel | Signal | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Circuit-breaker state by dependency | breaker open/half-open/closed | Shows *why* traffic is being shed before the error rate explains it |
| Timeouts per dependency | timeout counter | Distinguishes a slow dependency from a failing one |
| Retry rate and retry success ratio | retry counters | A high retry rate that still succeeds is masking a real problem |
| Fallback / degraded-response rate | fallback counter | Confirms graceful degradation actually engaged |

Until then, degradation is visible on the [API Overview](d/scp-api-overview) dashboard as a rise in 5xx and latency.
